name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre discovered his passion for motorsport while tinkering with his father's snowmobiles in rural Quebec. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in quality assurance, and quickly found his way into the racing world. His career began with a smaller rally team, where he honed his skills in identifying and resolving mechanical issues under immense pressure.

Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous attention to detail and calm demeanor, even when facing critical deadlines. He joined Toyota Gazoo Racing BR to contribute to a team with a strong reputation and ambitious goals. He believes that a proactive approach to quality control is essential for achieving consistent performance and minimizing risks on the track, a philosophy he applies daily.

Jean-Pierre is distinctive for his pragmatic approach and ability to quickly assess the root cause of problems. He is also known for his quiet but firm leadership, ensuring that quality standards are consistently met throughout the team.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on double-checking torque settings, even when they've already been verified.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
